messages:
Keiko Watanabe: hey everyone :wave: i'm keiko, started today as product marketing (she/her). moving back to town from tokyo, hybrid. love ramen, pet rocks, and very bad puns. excited to meet y'all!
Riley Moore: welcome keiko!! :tada: ramen recommendations are mandatory. also the pet-rock club meets in #random on fridays (bring a photo).
Samir Goyal: hi keiko, welcome :heart: quick logistics: badge pickup is in reception, desk assignments posted in the wiki. are you team shio or tonkotsu?
Keiko Watanabe: @Samir tonkotsu all the way. also my pet rock is named "boulder" and he prefers jazz.
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Keiko! To-do: badge pickup, equipment request form, benefits intro. Links: <https://intranet/onboard|onboarding checklist>  <https://intranet/equip|equipment form>. Reply "help" for assistance.
Riley Moore: tiny poll: choose a plant guardian role for Keiko's desk plant 
Samir Goyal: 1) Water weekly :droplet: 2) Sun-saver (near window) :seedling: 3) Snack protector (keeps snacks company) :cookie:
Keiko Watanabe: 2 please  i'll accept all responsibilities.
PlantBot: Assigned plant: snake plant. Care tips: low water, indirect light. Reminder set for Friday morning.
Riley Moore: also FYI we have a ramen crawl this saturday  if you want in i'll drop details.
Keiko Watanabe: count me in! and if anyone wants to hear the worst ramen-related puns, i've got a whole repertoire.
Samir Goyal: welcome aboard and bring boulder for a nose-boop intro (rocks are surprisingly photogenic).
Keiko Watanabe: will do :camera_with_flash: thanks everyone for the warm welcome :heart:
